declarations.description:
A month (or year) picker, like the billing-period and card-expiry pickers of Stripe and the month view of every
calendar: a year with its twelve months, and the title button opens a grid of years to jump between them. The value
is a `YYYY-MM` string, as an `<input type="month">` gives, or `YYYY` with `granularity="year"`.

`min` and `max` disable the months (or years) outside them and stop the paging there. Month names come from the
page's language (`Intl.DateTimeFormat`). The months are a grid with one tab stop: the arrow keys move by month and by
row, Home and End go to the start and end of a row, Page Up and Page Down change the year (or the page of years), and
Enter or Space picks.

It is a form control: under a `name` the form receives the value, `required` asks for one, and inside a
`c2-form-field` the field's label names it and its hint and error describe it.
declarations.name: MonthPicker

cssParts.description: The row with the paging buttons and the title.
cssParts.name: header

cssParts.description: The title button: the year, or the range of years.
cssParts.name: title

cssParts.name: grid

members.name: value
members.description: The month picked, as `YYYY-MM`, or the year as `YYYY` with `granularity="year"`.

members.name: granularity
members.description: Pick a month, or only a year.

members.name: min
members.description: The earliest month (or year) that can be picked, in the same format as `value`.

members.name: max
members.description: The latest month (or year) that can be picked, in the same format as `value`.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name: the form receives the value under it.

members.name: required
members.description: Asks for a value before the form submits.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Turns the picker off; the value is kept and, as for a disabled form control, not submitted.

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the picker. Inside a `c2-form-field`, the field's label names it.

members.name: viewYear
members.description: The year whose months are shown.

members.name: view
members.description: Months of a year, or a page of years.

members.name: focusKey
members.description: The cell that holds the grid's tab stop: a `YYYY-MM` month or a `YYYY` year.

members.name: valueYear
members.description: The year of the value, as `YYYY`.

members.name: showValue
members.description: Brings the picked value (or today) into view.

members.name: bound
members.description: `min`/`max` as months, a bare year standing for its first or last month.

members.name: keys
members.description: The keys of the cells shown, in reading order.

members.name: tabStop
members.description: The cell holding the tab stop: the one last focused, else the value, else the current month or year, else the first enabled.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired when the user picks a month (or year), before `change`. Read `value`.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired after the user picks a month (or year). Not fired for programmatic changes.
